content.user_title: Guide Spec-Kit Workflows for Claude Code
content.value_statement: Specification-driven projects can lose consistency when prompts, repository rules, and implementation steps are managed separately. This skill helps teams align Spec-Kit practices with Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of root and folder-specific CLAUDE.md workflow rules.
Defines specification formatting practices for clear and testable requirements.
Helps connect Claude Code implementation work to written specifications.
Supports prompt iteration cycles and reuse of effective prompt patterns.
Provides quality checks for specification alignment, implementation quality, and workflow consistency.
limitations: Does not create or modify files by itself.
Does not replace project-specific architecture decisions.
Requires existing requirements or specifications to be most useful.
Focuses on workflow guidance, not runtime code analysis.

use_cases.title: Start a Specification-First Project
use_cases.description: Plan repository rules, specification structure, and Claude Code prompts before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Standardize Multi-Folder Guidance
use_cases.description: Create consistent root and folder-specific development instructions for a repository.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Prompt Practices
use_cases.description: Document prompt patterns, feedback cycles, and quality checks for repeated AI-assisted development.

prompt_templates.title: Map the Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a Spec-Kit and Claude Code workflow for my repository. Include specification steps, CLAUDE.md guidance, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create Folder Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a multi-folder codebase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to propose root and folder-specific CLAUDE.md guidance for this repository structure. Keep global rules separate from local rules.

prompt_templates.title: Align Implementation with Specs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to connect these feature specifications to a Claude Code implementation plan. Include traceability, validation steps, and clarification questions.

prompt_templates.title: Refine the Full Process
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced improvement after several development cycles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review our Spec-Kit and Claude Code workflow. Identify weak feedback loops, prompt reuse opportunities, and quality checks to improve.

output_examples.input: A team wants to start a new feature with existing requirements and Claude Code assistance.
output_examples.output: A specification-first workflow with planning steps, Claude Code context guidance, acceptance checks, and review points.

output_examples.input: A repository has several folders with different coding conventions.
output_examples.output: A guidance plan that separates repository-wide instructions from folder-specific rules and expected implementation behavior.

output_examples.input: A team wants to improve repeated prompts across development cycles.
output_examples.output: A prompt refinement process with feedback collection, reusable prompt patterns, and workflow quality checks.

best_practices: Keep specifications clear, testable, and connected to implementation tasks.
Separate repository-wide guidance from folder-specific rules.
Review Claude Code outputs against acceptance criteria before merging work.
anti_patterns: Using the workflow when the project has no meaningful requirements.
Treating generated code as correct without specification validation.
Duplicating conflicting rules across multiple CLAUDE.md files.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It guides workflow planning and specification alignment for AI-assisted coding.

faq.question: Can I use it without Spec-Kit?
faq.answer: It is designed for Spec-Kit concepts, but the workflow ideas may help other specification-first processes.

faq.question: Does it require Claude Code?
faq.answer: Claude Code is the primary target, but the guidance also supports Claude and Codex workflows.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide repository structure, existing specifications, project constraints, and team coding standards.

faq.question: Is this useful for prototypes?
faq.answer: It is less useful for quick prototypes where formal specifications would slow the work.

faq.question: How should teams adopt it?
faq.answer: Start with one feature, document the workflow, then refine prompts and checks after implementation.
